title.narrative: Support to policy dialogue, evaluation, lessons learning

description.narrative: The component coordinates monitoring and learning initiatives across the programme and uses products to support evidence-based policy initiatives. A programme-funded adviser (PFA), based in the National Directorate for Water Supply and Sanitation (DNAAS), works closely with the other programme stakeholders to enhance the uptake and use of evidence in the programmes to improve programme implementation and policy making.

mailing-address.narrative: Public Enquiry Point, Abercrombie House, Eaglesham Road, East Kilbride, Glasgow G75 8EA
